name: Rising Giant Wordmark
note: A wordmark fitted to the container width and sunk into the footer's floor; each letter is a damped spring whose target is a Gaussian of pointer distance, and the floor fade is a mask on the stage rather than the glyphs, so a rising letter comes up fully lit. Three nested layers keep the reveal, the spring and the focus lift off each other's transform.
